newsitem.title: USA: U.S West Coast lt. crude falls amid lack of buyers.
newsitem.headline: U.S West Coast lt. crude falls amid lack of buyers.

text.p: U.S. West Coast light crude prices ended trade lower Monday, with West Texas Intermediate (WTI) leading local crudes downward amid a lack of trade for Alaskan crude, traders said Monday.

Traders remained uncertain if a cargo of Alaska North Slope (ANS) crude sold late last week at a higher price than the $1.53 discount done January 8. A rumor ANS was done better than that level circulated Friday.
The grade's dominant seller, BP America, on Monday offered at $1.25 a barrel under February WTI for February delivery, but reported no bids in response.
